    static int k, mod = 1000000007, F, H;
    static long[][] comb;
    static int[][][] dp1;
    static int[][][][] dp2;
    static boolean[][][] vis;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (sc.nextInt() == 50) F++;
            else H++;
        }

        comb = new long[100][100];
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) Arrays.fill(comb[i], -1);

        // BFS for min steps
        int min = bfs();
        if (min > 100000) {
            System.out.println(-1);
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        // Bottom-up DP for number of ways
        dp2 = new int[2][51][51][min + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 51; j++)
                for (int l = 0; l < 51; l++)
                    Arrays.fill(dp2[i][j][l], -1);

        // Initialize base cases for step 0
        for (int side = 0; side < 2; side++) {
            for (int f = 0; f <= F; f++) {
                for (int h = 0; h <= H; h++) {
                    if (f + h == 0 && side == 0) dp2[side][f][h][0] = 1;
                    if (f == F && h == H && side == 1) dp2[side][f][h][0] = 1;
                }
            }
        }

        // Fill DP for steps 1..min
        for (int s = 1; s <= min; s++) {
            for (int side = 0; side < 2; side++) {
                for (int f = 0; f <= F; f++) {
                    for (int h = 0; h <= H; h++) {
                        int ans = 0;
                        for (int ff = 0; ff <= f; ff++) {
                            for (int hh = 0; hh <= h; hh++) {
                                if (ff + hh == 0 || hh * 100 + ff * 50 > k) continue;
                                int nf = F - f + ff;
                                int nh = H - h + hh;
                                int ns = 1 ^ side;
                                if (dp2[ns][nf][nh][s - 1] != -1) {
                                    ans = (int)((ans + (nCr1(f, ff) * nCr1(h, hh) % mod * dp2[ns][nf][nh][s - 1]) % mod) % mod);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (ans != 0) dp2[side][f][h][s] = ans;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(min);
        System.out.println(dp2[0][F][H][min] == -1 ? 0 : dp2[0][F][H][min]);

        pw.flush();
        pw.close();
    }

    static int bfs() {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        boolean[][][] visited = new boolean[2][51][51];
        int[][][] dist = new int[2][51][51];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 51; j++)
                Arrays.fill(dist[i][j], Integer.MAX_VALUE);

        q.add(new int[]{F, H, 0});
        visited[0][F][H] = true;
        dist[0][F][H] = 0;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int f = cur[0], h = cur[1], side = cur[2];
            int d = dist[side][f][h];

            if (f + h == 0 && side == 0) return d;
            if (f == F && h == H && side == 1) return d;

            for (int ff = 0; ff <= f; ff++) {
                for (int hh = 0; hh <= h; hh++) {
                    if (ff + hh == 0 || hh * 100 + ff * 50 > k) continue;
                    int nf = F - f + ff;
                    int nh = H - h + hh;
                    int ns = 1 ^ side;
                    if (!visited[ns][nf][nh]) {
                        visited[ns][nf][nh] = true;
                        dist[ns][nf][nh] = d + 1;
                        q.add(new int[]{nf, nh, ns});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
    }

    static long nCr1(int n, int k) {
        if (n < k) return 0;
        if (k == 0 || k == n) return 1;
        if (comb[n][k] != -1) return comb[n][k];
        if (n - k < k) return comb[n][k] = nCr1(n, n - k);
        return comb[n][k] = (nCr1(n - 1, k - 1) + nCr1(n - 1, k)) % mod;
    }

        StringTokenizer st; BufferedReader br;
        public Scanner(InputStream s) { br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(s)); }
        public String next() throws IOException { while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine()); return st.nextToken(); }
        public int nextInt() throws IOException { return Integer.parseInt(next()); }
    }
}

        fact = new long[101];
        invFact = new long[101];
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 100; i++) fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % mod;

        for (int i = 99; i >= 0; i--) invFact[i] = invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod;

        dp1 = new int[2][51][51];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)

        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)

        System.out.println(min);
        System.out.println(solve2(F, H, 0, min));

        pw.flush();
        pw.close();

    static long modPow(long a, long e) {
        long res = 1;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) res = res * a % mod;
            a = a * a % mod;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long nCr1(int n, int k) {
        if (n < k || k < 0) return 0;
        return fact[n] * invFact[k] % mod * invFact[n - k] % mod;
    }

    static int solve(int fifty, int hundred, int side) {
        if (fifty + hundred == 0 && side == 0) return 0;
        if (fifty == F && hundred == H && side == 1) return 0;

        vis[side][fifty][hundred] = true;
        int ans = 1000000000;
        for (int ff = 0; ff <= fifty; ff++)
            for (int hh = 0; hh <= hundred; hh++) {
                if (ff + hh == 0 || hh * 100 + ff * 50 > k) continue;
                ans = Math.min(ans, 1 + solve(F - fifty + ff, H - hundred + hh, 1 ^ side));
            }
        return dp1[side][fifty][hundred] = ans;

    static int solve2(int fifty, int hundred, int side, int min) {
